announcement.title: 🛍️ Stylish Shop v2.2.0
announcement.content:
In Shop Settings under Products & stock, open a category's Stock pool and choose Dice formula.

  • Roll product counts and stock with formulas such as 2d6 or 1d6 + 2. Set a default stock formula or override it per item.
  • Roll each product's price with a formula such as 3d6 * 100 and select a system or GlitchSmith Library currency. Individual items can use their own formula or source price. Currency rounding, shop multipliers and discounts apply; random price variance is disabled for rolled prices.
  • Applying keeps the preview's quantities and prices. Scheduled Stock Pool rotation rerolls them; Restock All refills the last rolled stock and keeps the rolled prices.
  • World Stock Pool presets save formulas, selected currencies and per-item settings. These rolls do not appear in chat.
